_comment: Alert rules (SRS Steps 15-17, FR xl-liii, deliverable 7). This file seeds the database the first time the web app runs; administrators then change rules and thresholds in the app, and can export them back to this format. Confidences are the Python model's calibrated probabilities (0-1).

settings._min_confidence: Below this the result is Low confidence: uncertain and routed to manual review (FR xxxv). Chosen from validation data: reports/threshold_study.md.
settings._top_two_margin: If the best and second-best class are closer than this, the result is uncertain (FR xxxvi).
settings._weak_match_difference: Same class from both models but their top confidences differ by more than this: Weak Match instead of Acceptable Match.
settings._overlap_threshold: Two or more event classes each at or above this probability in one window: possible overlapping sounds (FR xxxix). Background Noise and Normal Machinery do not count.
settings._unknown_confidence: Below this the sound is reported as Unknown instead of a class (FR li).
settings._repeat_window_seconds: Live monitoring: detections of the same class within this many seconds count as repeated detections (Step 15).

rules.recommended_action: Treat as a possible firearm discharge: alert security, check cameras for the location, keep people away until cleared.
rules.manual_review: Always when the two models disagree or confirmation fails (possible fireworks or vehicle backfire).
